prompt: Can you explain the difference between @theme and @theme inline in Tailwind v4? I'm trying to set up dark mode and I'm confused about which one to use. Someone told me @theme inline breaks dark mode but I'm also seeing it used in shadcn/ui which has working dark mode.
assertions: Correctly states that plain @theme generates utilities that reference var(--color-*) at runtime
Correctly explains that @theme inline with a var() value (like var(--background)) still works for dark mode because the browser resolves the var at render time
Identifies the calc() gotcha: calc() expressions in @theme inline are baked in at build time and won't respond to runtime changes to the base variable
Provides a concrete example showing the shadcn pattern (semantic vars in :root/.dark, aliased via @theme inline)
Gives a recommendation: use @theme inline for semantic tokens coming from :root/.dark, plain @theme for primitives or derived spacing/radius tokens that need runtime cascading
